prose: The Financial Times reports that experts warn slow US grid expansion could stifle the AI boom and give China an edge, as China builds power infrastructure faster. The US is building electricity lines at a quarter of the rate of a decade ago.
highlights: Experts: slow US grid expansion could hobble AI and favor China
US building power lines at a quarter of the rate of a decade ago, per FT
basis: Error cache: FT paywall. Written from the Techmeme headline and lede.
